annotations.text:
Every preview here is real output from the pipeline — Ayat al-Kursi, Al-Ikhlas and Al-Fatihah rendered by the composer, not placeholder art.

The checkerboard is the UI telling you the PNG is genuinely transparent.
Bilingual: the desktop board is the English view (the Canva audience searches in English), the phone board is the Arabic RTL view. Same page, AR | EN in the header.
